---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m4p4t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, Cap, MaxOverrides, Lobbies

VARIABLES status, paused, overrides, lobby

vars == <<status, paused, overrides, lobby>>

Queued == { p \in Players : status[p] = "queued" }

TypeInvariant ==
    /\ status \in [Players -> {"waiting", "queued", "matched"}]
    /\ paused \in BOOLEAN
    /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOverrides
    /\ lobby \in [Players -> 0..Lobbies]

Init ==
    /\ status = [p \in Players |-> "waiting"]
    /\ paused = FALSE
    /\ overrides = 0
    /\ lobby = [p \in Players |-> 0]

Enqueue(p) ==
    /\ status[p] = "waiting"
    /\ ~paused
    /\ Cardinality(Queued) < Cap
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p] = "queued"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<paused, overrides, lobby>>

AdminOverride(p) ==
    /\ status[p] = "waiting"
    /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
    /\ Cardinality(Queued) < Cap
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p] = "queued"]
    /\ overrides' = overrides + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<paused, lobby>>

Match(p) ==
    /\ status[p] = "queued"
    /\ \E g \in 1..Lobbies :
         /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p] = "matched"]
         /\ lobby' = [lobby EXCEPT ![p] = g]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<paused, overrides>>

Recycle(p) ==
    /\ status[p] = "matched"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p] = "waiting"]
    /\ lobby' = [lobby EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<paused, overrides>>

RaiseBackpressure ==
    /\ ~paused
    /\ Cardinality(Queued) >= Cap
    /\ paused' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, overrides, lobby>>

Resume ==
    /\ paused
    /\ Cardinality(Queued) = 0
    /\ paused' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, overrides, lobby>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Enqueue(p) \/ AdminOverride(p) \/ Match(p) \/ Recycle(p)
    \/ RaiseBackpressure
    \/ Resume

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected == Cardinality(Queued) <= Cap
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Players = {p1, p2, p3, p4}
    Cap = 2
    MaxOverrides = 2
    Lobbies = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl: A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker admits waiting players into a match-staging queue of bounded size. Players begin in a waiting pool; the matchmaker moves a waiting player into the staging queue only while the queue has room and normal intake is not paused. When the staging queue fills to its cap, the matchmaker raises a backpressure flag that pauses ordinary intake, and it lowers that flag again only once the queue has fully drained. Staged players are eventually pulled into an actual match, which frees their slot and increments a served tally. A privileged admin can override the paused state and inject a waiting player directly into the staging queue, but the admin injection still respects the hard cap and is limited to a small number of uses. The cap is a fixed resource limit that no code path, admin or otherwise, may breach. SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of players occupying the staging queue never exceeds the fixed queue capacity.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m6p2t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Patrons, TotalCopies, MaxHold, MaxLease, MaxOverdue

VARIABLES pool, held, lease, overdue

vars == <<pool, held, lease, overdue>>

RECURSIVE SumHeld(_)
SumHeld(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN held[x] + SumHeld(S \ {x})

TotalHeld == SumHeld(Patrons)

TypeInvariant ==
    /\ pool \in 0..TotalCopies
    /\ held \in [Patrons -> 0..MaxHold]
    /\ lease \in [Patrons -> 0..MaxLease]
    /\ overdue \in [Patrons -> 0..MaxOverdue]

Init ==
    /\ pool = TotalCopies
    /\ held = [p \in Patrons |-> 0]
    /\ lease = [p \in Patrons |-> 0]
    /\ overdue = [p \in Patrons |-> 0]

Reserve(p) ==
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ held[p] < MaxHold
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = held[p] + 1]
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![p] = MaxLease]
    /\ UNCHANGED overdue

Return(p) ==
    /\ held[p] > 0
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = held[p] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, overdue>>

Renew(p) ==
    /\ held[p] > 0
    /\ lease[p] > 0
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![p] = MaxLease]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, overdue>>

Tick ==
    /\ \E p \in Patrons : lease[p] > 0
    /\ lease' = [p \in Patrons |-> IF lease[p] > 0 THEN lease[p] - 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, overdue>>

Expire(p) ==
    /\ held[p] > 0
    /\ lease[p] = 0
    /\ overdue[p] < MaxOverdue
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = held[p] - 1]
    /\ overdue' = [overdue EXCEPT ![p] = overdue[p] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED lease

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Reserve(p) \/ Return(p) \/ Renew(p) \/ Expire(p)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CopiesConserved == pool + TotalHeld = TotalCopies
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Patrons = {a, b}
    TotalCopies = 3
    MaxHold = 2
    MaxLease = 2
    MaxOverdue = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CopiesConserved
nl: A library manages a fixed number of identical copies of a popular title using lease-based reservations. Every copy is either sitting in the available pool or currently leased to one of the patrons, and each patron may hold several copies at once up to a personal limit. When a patron reserves a copy, one copy leaves the pool and a countdown lease is stamped on that patron's holdings; a patron may voluntarily return a copy to the pool at any time. A patron can be slow to renew but never fails outright: as the shared clock ticks, every active lease counts down, and when a patron's lease reaches zero one of their copies automatically expires back into the pool and their overdue tally rises. A patron may renew before expiry, which refreshes the countdown without moving any copy. Copies are never manufactured or shredded by any of these operations; they only move between the pool and patrons. SAFETY PROPERTY: The pool count plus the total copies held across all patrons always equals the fixed number of copies the library owns.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m9p6t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES lockEpoch, state, ctrlEpoch, authorized, requests, granted

vars == <<lockEpoch, state, ctrlEpoch, authorized, requests, granted>>

Requests == [ctrl : Controllers, epoch : 0..MaxEpoch]

TypeInvariant ==
    /\ lockEpoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ state \in {"locked", "open"}
    /\ ctrlEpoch \in [Controllers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ authorized \in SUBSET Controllers
    /\ requests \in SUBSET Requests
    /\ granted \in [ctrl : Controllers, epoch : 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
    /\ lockEpoch = 0
    /\ state = "locked"
    /\ ctrlEpoch = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ authorized = Controllers
    /\ requests = {}
    /\ granted = [ctrl |-> CHOOSE c \in Controllers : TRUE, epoch |-> 0]

SendUnlock(c) ==
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {[ctrl |-> c, epoch |-> ctrlEpoch[c]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockEpoch, state, ctrlEpoch, authorized, granted>>

Reconfigure(c) ==
    /\ state = "locked"
    /\ c \in authorized
    /\ lockEpoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ lockEpoch' = lockEpoch + 1
    /\ ctrlEpoch' = [ctrlEpoch EXCEPT ![c] = lockEpoch + 1]
    /\ authorized' = {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<state, requests, granted>>

DeliverValid(m) ==
    /\ m \in requests
    /\ m.ctrl \in authorized
    /\ m.epoch = lockEpoch
    /\ state' = "open"
    /\ granted' = m
    /\ requests' = requests \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockEpoch, ctrlEpoch, authorized>>

DeliverStale(m) ==
    /\ m \in requests
    /\ (m.ctrl \notin authorized \/ m.epoch # lockEpoch)
    /\ requests' = requests \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockEpoch, state, ctrlEpoch, authorized, granted>>

Secure(c) ==
    /\ state = "open"
    /\ c \in authorized
    /\ ctrlEpoch[c] = lockEpoch
    /\ state' = "locked"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockEpoch, ctrlEpoch, authorized, requests, granted>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : SendUnlock(c) \/ Reconfigure(c) \/ Secure(c)
    \/ \E m \in requests : DeliverValid(m) \/ DeliverStale(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LockControlledByCurrentConfig ==
    (state = "open") => (granted.epoch = lockEpoch /\ granted.ctrl \in authorized)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LockControlledByCurrentConfig
nl: A smart-home door lock is driven by a small network of controllers, each of which caches an epoch number describing the lock's current configuration. The lock itself tracks the authoritative epoch and the set of controllers currently authorized to command it. An owner reconfigures the lock only while it is secured: reconfiguration bumps the authoritative epoch, promotes the initiating controller to the new epoch, and revokes every other controller, leaving them stale. Any controller may broadcast an unlock request stamped with the epoch it currently believes is valid, and because the home network reorders traffic, these requests sit in an unordered pool and may be delivered in any order at any later time. The lock opens for a delivered request only when the sender is still authorized and its stamped epoch matches the authoritative epoch; requests that are stale or from revoked controllers are dropped without effect. An authorized current controller may re-secure an open lock. SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the lock is open, it was opened by a request whose sender is currently authorized and whose stamped epoch equals the lock's authoritative epoch.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m7p0t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Students, Cap, MaxVersion

VARIABLES owner, status, version, enrolled

vars == <<owner, status, version, enrolled>>

Free == "free"

TypeInvariant ==
    /\ owner \in Students \cup {Free}
    /\ status \in [Students -> {"idle", "waiting", "using", "crashed"}]
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVersion
    /\ enrolled \in 0..Cap

Init ==
    /\ owner = Free
    /\ status = [s \in Students |-> "idle"]
    /\ version = 0
    /\ enrolled = 0

Bump == IF version < MaxVersion THEN version + 1 ELSE 0

Want(s) ==
    /\ status[s] = "idle"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![s] = "waiting"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, version, enrolled>>

Acquire(s) ==
    /\ status[s] = "waiting"
    /\ owner = Free
    /\ owner' = s
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![s] = "using"]
    /\ version' = Bump
    /\ UNCHANGED enrolled

Release(s) ==
    /\ status[s] = "using"
    /\ owner = s
    /\ owner' = Free
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ version' = Bump
    /\ enrolled' = IF enrolled = Cap THEN 1 ELSE enrolled + 1

Crash(s) ==
    /\ status[s] \in {"waiting", "using"}
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![s] = "crashed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, version, enrolled>>

Recover(s) ==
    /\ status[s] = "crashed"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ owner' = IF owner = s THEN Free ELSE owner
    /\ version' = IF owner = s THEN Bump ELSE version
    /\ UNCHANGED enrolled

Next == \E s \in Students : Want(s) \/ Acquire(s) \/ Release(s) \/ Crash(s) \/ Recover(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CriticalSectionGuarded == \A s \in Students : status[s] = "using" => owner = s
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Students = {s1, s2, s3}
    Cap = 2
    MaxVersion = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CriticalSectionGuarded
nl: A university course-registration system guards the single write slot for a course's roster with a compare-and-swap register. The register holds either the token "free" or the identity of the student currently editing the roster, together with a version stamp that increments on every successful swap. A student acquires the slot by compare-and-swapping the register from "free" to their own identity, which moves them into the editing state; they later release it by swapping their identity back to "free" and advancing the roster's enrolled tally. Exactly one student at a time may be in the editing critical section. Any student can crash silently while waiting or editing: they simply stop, and if they were holding the slot the register stays stuck on their identity until a recovery step reclaims it. A recovering crashed student returns to idle, freeing the register if they still owned it. SAFETY PROPERTY: If a student is in the editing critical section, the compare-and-swap register names that same student as its current owner.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m8p2t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Workers, Trays, TotalJobs, TrayCap

VARIABLES coarse, fine, spool, onTray, printed

vars == <<coarse, fine, spool, onTray, printed>>

Free == "free"

RECURSIVE SumTray(_)
SumTray(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET t == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN onTray[t] + SumTray(S \ {t})

TotalOnTrays == SumTray(Trays)

TypeInvariant ==
    /\ coarse \in Workers \cup {Free}
    /\ fine \in [Trays -> Workers \cup {Free}]
    /\ spool \in 0..TotalJobs
    /\ onTray \in [Trays -> 0..TrayCap]
    /\ printed \in 0..TotalJobs

Init ==
    /\ coarse = Free
    /\ fine = [t \in Trays |-> Free]
    /\ spool = TotalJobs
    /\ onTray = [t \in Trays |-> 0]
    /\ printed = 0

AcquireCoarse(w) ==
    /\ coarse = Free
    /\ coarse' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, spool, onTray, printed>>

ReleaseCoarse(w) ==
    /\ coarse = w
    /\ \A t \in Trays : fine[t] # w
    /\ coarse' = Free
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, spool, onTray, printed>>

AcquireFine(w, t) ==
    /\ coarse = w
    /\ fine[t] = Free
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![t] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, spool, onTray, printed>>

ReleaseFine(w, t) ==
    /\ fine[t] = w
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![t] = Free]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, spool, onTray, printed>>

LoadTray(w, t) ==
    /\ coarse = w
    /\ fine[t] = w
    /\ spool > 0
    /\ onTray[t] < TrayCap
    /\ spool' = spool - 1
    /\ onTray' = [onTray EXCEPT ![t] = onTray[t] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, printed>>

Print(w, t) ==
    /\ coarse = w
    /\ fine[t] = w
    /\ onTray[t] > 0
    /\ onTray' = [onTray EXCEPT ![t] = onTray[t] - 1]
    /\ printed' = printed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, spool>>

Rework ==
    /\ printed > 0
    /\ spool < TotalJobs
    /\ printed' = printed - 1
    /\ spool' = spool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, onTray>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : AcquireCoarse(w) \/ ReleaseCoarse(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, t \in Trays :
         AcquireFine(w, t) \/ ReleaseFine(w, t) \/ LoadTray(w, t) \/ Print(w, t)
    \/ Rework

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

JobsConserved == spool + TotalOnTrays + printed = TotalJobs
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Workers = {w1, w2}
    Trays = {t1, t2}
    TotalJobs = 3
    TrayCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT JobsConserved
nl: A print shop spooler coordinates workers that move jobs through a printer using two tiers of locks. The printer has one coarse lock, and each output tray underneath it has its own fine lock. Following a strict hierarchical discipline, a worker must first hold the coarse printer lock before it may take any tray's fine lock, and it releases fine locks before giving up the coarse lock. Holding the coarse lock and a tray's fine lock, a worker may load a job from the shared spool onto that tray, or print a loaded job from that tray into the finished pile. A worker may be slow to release its locks but never fails, so other workers simply wait their turn. Jobs are never fabricated or lost by any operation; a load only relocates a job from the spool to a tray, printing only relocates it from a tray to the finished pile, and reworking moves a finished job back to the spool. SAFETY PROPERTY: The spool count plus the jobs sitting on all trays plus the finished jobs always equals the fixed total number of jobs in the shop.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m5p6t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers, Flights, Quorum, MaxTerm

VARIABLES allocated, mode, pendingFor, support, term, authorized

vars == <<allocated, mode, pendingFor, support, term, authorized>>

None == "none"

TypeInvariant ==
    /\ allocated \in Flights \cup {None}
    /\ mode \in {"none", "quorum", "admin"}
    /\ pendingFor \in Flights \cup {None}
    /\ support \in SUBSET Controllers
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ authorized \in SUBSET Controllers

Init ==
    /\ allocated = None
    /\ mode = "none"
    /\ pendingFor = None
    /\ support = {}
    /\ term = 0
    /\ authorized = Controllers

Vote(c, f) ==
    /\ mode = "none"
    /\ c \in authorized
    /\ (pendingFor = None \/ pendingFor = f)
    /\ support' = support \cup {c}
    /\ pendingFor' = f
    /\ UNCHANGED <<allocated, mode, term, authorized>>

Commit ==
    /\ mode = "none"
    /\ pendingFor # None
    /\ support \subseteq authorized
    /\ Cardinality(support) >= Quorum
    /\ allocated' = pendingFor
    /\ mode' = "quorum"
    /\ pendingFor' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<support, term, authorized>>

AdminGrant(f) ==
    /\ mode = "none"
    /\ allocated' = f
    /\ mode' = "admin"
    /\ support' = {}
    /\ pendingFor' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, authorized>>

Release ==
    /\ mode \in {"quorum", "admin"}
    /\ allocated' = None
    /\ mode' = "none"
    /\ support' = {}
    /\ pendingFor' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, authorized>>

Reconfigure(A) ==
    /\ mode = "none"
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ A # {}
    /\ authorized' = A
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ support' = {}
    /\ pendingFor' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<allocated, mode>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Flights : Vote(c, f)
    \/ Commit
    \/ \E f \in Flights : AdminGrant(f)
    \/ Release
    \/ \E A \in SUBSET Controllers : Reconfigure(A)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

QuorumBackedAllocation ==
    (allocated # None /\ mode = "quorum")
        => (support \subseteq authorized /\ Cardinality(support) >= Quorum)
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2, c3}
    Flights = {f1, f2}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxTerm = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT QuorumBackedAllocation
nl: An air-traffic control tower allocates its single active runway to at most one flight at a time, and every ordinary allocation must be backed by a quorum vote of the authorized controllers. While no allocation is in progress, authorized controllers cast votes for a particular waiting flight; their support accumulates until it forms a quorum. A commit step then hands the runway to the voted flight, recording the supporting controllers as the justification for that grant. The roster of authorized controllers is only reconfigured while the runway is idle, which bumps the configuration term and discards any partial votes so that stale or revoked controllers cannot influence a later grant. A privileged supervisor may override the vote entirely and grant the runway directly in an emergency, a path that is exempt from the quorum requirement. When the runway is released it returns to idle. SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the runway holds an ordinary (non-supervisor) allocation, the recorded supporters are all currently authorized controllers and number at least a quorum.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m5p1t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robots, MaxVer

VARIABLES ver, lastBase, hasProp, pbase, packs, active

vars == <<ver, lastBase, hasProp, pbase, packs, active>>

Quorum(A) == Cardinality(A) \div 2 + 1

TypeInvariant ==
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ lastBase \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ hasProp \in [Robots -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ pbase \in [Robots -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ packs \in [Robots -> SUBSET Robots]
    /\ active \in SUBSET Robots

Init ==
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ lastBase = 0
    /\ hasProp = [r \in Robots |-> FALSE]
    /\ pbase = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
    /\ packs = [r \in Robots |-> {}]
    /\ active = Robots

Propose(r) ==
    /\ ~hasProp[r]
    /\ r \in active
    /\ hasProp' = [hasProp EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ pbase' = [pbase EXCEPT ![r] = ver]
    /\ packs' = [packs EXCEPT ![r] = {r}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, lastBase, active>>

Ack(r, q) ==
    /\ hasProp[r]
    /\ q \in active
    /\ packs' = [packs EXCEPT ![r] = packs[r] \cup {q}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, lastBase, hasProp, pbase, active>>

Commit(r) ==
    /\ hasProp[r]
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ pbase[r] = ver
    /\ packs[r] \subseteq active
    /\ Cardinality(packs[r]) >= Quorum(active)
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ lastBase' = pbase[r]
    /\ hasProp' = [hasProp EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ pbase' = [pbase EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ packs' = [packs EXCEPT ![r] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED active

Abort(r) ==
    /\ hasProp[r]
    /\ hasProp' = [hasProp EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ pbase' = [pbase EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ packs' = [packs EXCEPT ![r] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, lastBase, active>>

ChangeCapacity(A) ==
    /\ A # {}
    /\ A # active
    /\ active' = A
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, lastBase, hasProp, pbase, packs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Propose(r) \/ Commit(r) \/ Abort(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots, q \in Robots : Ack(r, q)
    \/ \E A \in SUBSET Robots : ChangeCapacity(A)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate == ver > 0 => lastBase = ver - 1
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2}
    MaxVer = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl: A warehouse robot fleet shares one inventory record that carries a value and a version stamp. To change the record a robot first reads the current version and opens a proposal stamped with that base version, then collects acknowledgements from its peers. Because the fleet uses quorum voting, a proposal may be committed only once a quorum of the currently active robots has acknowledged it. Critically, a proposal commits only if its base version still equals the record's live version; if another robot committed in the meantime, the base is stale and the proposal must be aborted and retried so that no update silently overwrites a newer one. The fleet capacity changes at runtime as robots power on or off, which shifts the active set and therefore the size of the quorum. Each successful commit advances the version by one and records the base it was applied against. SAFETY PROPERTY: Every committed update was applied against the immediately preceding version, so the last recorded base version always equals the record's version minus one.

VARIABLES phase, sessionEpoch, makerEpoch, authorized, reg

vars == <<phase, sessionEpoch, makerEpoch, authorized, reg>>

None == "none"

TypeInvariant ==
    /\ phase \in {"open", "frozen"}
    /\ sessionEpoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ makerEpoch \in [Makers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ authorized \in SUBSET Makers
    /\ reg \in [ver : 0..MaxVer, writer : Makers \cup {None}, wepoch : 0..MaxEpoch]

    /\ sessionEpoch = 0
    /\ makerEpoch = [m \in Makers |-> 0]

    /\ reg = [ver |-> 0, writer |-> None, wepoch |-> 0]

    /\ m \in authorized
    /\ makerEpoch[m] = sessionEpoch
    /\ reg.ver < MaxVer
    /\ reg' = [ver |-> reg.ver + 1, writer |-> m, wepoch |-> makerEpoch[m]]

    /\ phase' = "frozen"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<sessionEpoch, makerEpoch, authorized, reg>>

    /\ phase' = "open"

    /\ authorized' = A
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, makerEpoch, reg>>

VARIABLES leader, status, dispensing, members, term

    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
    /\ status \in [Nodes -> {"up", "down"}]
    /\ dispensing \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ members \in SUBSET Nodes
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm

Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ status = [n \in Nodes |-> "down"]
    /\ dispensing = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ members = {}
    /\ term = 0

AddMember(n) ==
    /\ n \notin members
    /\ members' = members \cup {n}
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![n] = "up"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, dispensing, term>>

RemoveMember(n) ==
    /\ n \in members
    /\ n # leader
    /\ members' = members \ {n}
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![n] = "down"]
    /\ dispensing' = [dispensing EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ n \in members
    /\ status[n] = "up"
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, dispensing, members>>

Fail(n) ==
    /\ n \in members
    /\ status[n] = "up"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![n] = "down"]
    /\ dispensing' = [dispensing EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, members, term>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ n \in members
    /\ status[n] = "down"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![n] = "up"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, dispensing, members, term>>

StepDown ==
    /\ leader # None
    /\ status[leader] = "down"
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, dispensing, members, term>>

BeginDispense(n) ==
    /\ n = leader
    /\ status[n] = "up"
    /\ ~dispensing[n]
    /\ dispensing' = [dispensing EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, status, members, term>>

FinishDispense(n) ==
    /\ dispensing[n]
    /\ dispensing' = [dispensing EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, status, members, term>>

    \E n \in Nodes :

        \/ Recover(n) \/ BeginDispense(n) \/ FinishDispense(n)

nl: A pharmacy runs a cluster of dispenser nodes for controlled substances, but only one elected leader may operate the physical dispensing mechanism at any moment, so the mechanism is a mutually exclusive critical resource. When there is no live leader, any up node that is a member may win an election and become leader, consuming one election term.     /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, sessionEpoch, studentEpoch, authorized>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, fineOwner, sessionEpoch, studentEpoch, authorized>>

    /\ fineOwner[c] # None

    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, msgs, sessionEpoch, studentEpoch, authorized>>

    /\ sessionEpoch < MaxEpoch

    /\ authorized' = A
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, fineOwner, msgs, studentEpoch>>

    /\ studentEpoch[s] < sessionEpoch

            /\ fineOwner[c] \in authorized

To actually write, a controller must hold the write lease, which it acquires when the lease is free and which expires after a bounded time unless renewed; an expiring lease is released automatically, and a holder may also release it explicitly. AcquireBook(t) ==
    /\ bookLock = Free
    /\ bookLock' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<symLock, crossing, listed>>

ReleaseBook(t) ==
    /\ bookLock = t
    /\ \A s \in Symbols : symLock[s] # t
    /\ bookLock' = Free
    /\ UNCHANGED <<symLock, crossing, listed>>

AcquireSym(t, s) ==
    /\ s \in listed
    /\ bookLock = t
    /\ symLock[s] = Free
    /\ symLock' = [symLock EXCEPT ![s] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bookLock, crossing, listed>>

ReleaseSym(t, s) ==
    /\ symLock[s] = t
    /\ crossing[s] # t
    /\ symLock' = [symLock EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bookLock, crossing, listed>>

EnterCross(t, s) ==
    /\ bookLock = t
    /\ symLock[s] = t
    /\ crossing[s] = Free
    /\ crossing' = [crossing EXCEPT ![s] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bookLock, symLock, listed>>

ExitCross(t, s) ==
    /\ crossing[s] = t
    /\ crossing' = [crossing EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bookLock, symLock, listed>>

ListSymbol(s) ==
    /\ s \notin listed
    /\ symLock[s] = Free
    /\ crossing[s] = Free
    /\ listed' = listed \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bookLock, symLock, crossing>>

DelistSymbol(s) ==
    /\ s \in listed
    /\ symLock[s] = Free
    /\ crossing[s] = Free
    /\ listed' = listed \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bookLock, symLock, crossing>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Traders : AcquireBook(t) \/ ReleaseBook(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders, s \in Symbols :
         AcquireSym(t, s) \/ ReleaseSym(t, s) \/ EnterCross(t, s) \/ ExitCross(t, s)
    \/ \E s \in Symbols : ListSymbol(s) \/ DelistSymbol(s)

    \A s \in Symbols :
        crossing[s] # Free => (bookLock = crossing[s] /\ symLock[s] = crossing[s])

nl: A stock exchange opening auction lets traders cross orders for individual symbols under a two-tier hierarchical lock. There is one coarse lock on the whole auction book, and each listed symbol has its own fine lock. Following the hierarchical order, a trader must hold the coarse book lock before it may take any symbol's fine lock, and it releases fine locks before releasing the book lock. Holding both the book lock and a symbol's fine lock, a trader may enter the cross for that symbol, which is a mutually exclusive critical section, and later exit it. The set of listed symbols changes at runtime as listings are added or delisted; a symbol may be delisted only while its fine lock is free and no trader is crossing it, and a freshly listed symbol starts unlocked and uncrossed. Only the trader that holds both the book lock and a symbol's fine lock may be crossing that symbol. SAFETY PROPERTY: Any symbol currently being crossed is being crossed by the single trader that holds both the auction book lock and that symbol's fine lock.
